rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KEIbian
Exhibition name: French Perfume
rows.Origin:
Bred by Seizo Suzuki (Japan, before 1992).
Introduced in United States by Bear Creek Gardens, Inc. in 1993 as 'French Perfume'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, pink edges. Moderate, fruity, sweet fragrance. 25 to 30 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very double bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
